GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.5 (16 Nov 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 291)
16 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Chinese Nationals.
1. It has been brought to the attention of this headquarters that three hundred eighty-six (386) Chinese coolies located at Nanao, Ishikawa Prefecture have made trouble there.
2. It is desired that this personnel be returned to China in accordance with the provisions of Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 370.5 (1 Nov 45) GC, dated 1 November 1945, subject: "Repatriation of Non-Japanese From Japan".
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
